scenes.headline: Control Plane
scenes.subtitle: The brain that manages your Databricks account
scenes.narration: The control plane is the Databricks-managed layer that runs the web application, orchestration, and metadata for your account.

scenes.headline: What lives in the control plane
items: The workspace UI, notebooks, and REST APIs you interact with
Job scheduling, cluster orchestration, and configuration state
Query history, metadata, and encrypted notebook commands
scenes.narration: The control plane hosts the interfaces and services you touch directly. It schedules jobs and orchestrates clusters on your behalf. It also stores metadata and encrypted notebook commands, never your bulk data.

scenes.headline: Control plane vs data plane

columns.title: Control plane
points: Runs in the Databricks cloud account

columns.title: Data plane
points: Holds and processes your actual data

scenes.narration: The control plane lives in the Databricks-operated account and coordinates work. The data plane runs inside your own cloud subscription where compute and data reside. This split keeps your data under your control while Databricks manages the platform.

scenes.headline: How a job request flows
scenes.narration: When you launch a job, the control plane authenticates you and validates workspace permissions. It then instructs the data plane to provision compute and run the work. Results and status flow back to the control plane for you to observe.

scenes.headline: Why the separation matters
items: Sensitive data never leaves your cloud boundary
Databricks can upgrade the platform without touching your data
Security and compliance boundaries stay clear
scenes.narration: Keeping bulk data in your account satisfies data-residency and compliance requirements. Databricks can patch and improve the managed layer independently. The clean boundary makes security reviews far simpler.

scenes.text: The control plane orchestrates; the data plane computes. Your data stays in your cloud account.
scenes.narration: Think of the control plane as the conductor and the data plane as the orchestra. The conductor directs, but the music is played where your data lives.
